name: gh-account
description: Runs gh and git network commands as the GitHub account for their directory or org, with no gh auth switch

rules.title: Account rules
rules.description: Comma-separated <directory>=<account> or org:<org>=<account>, e.g. ~/work=me-work, org:acme=me-work. An org the command names wins, then the deepest directory it runs in. Empty: no rules.

default.title: Default account
default.description: The account for gh and git commands no rule matches. Empty: they run as the active gh account.
